definitions.gloss: sociability; friendliness; ability to get along with others
definitions.explanation: The personality trait of enjoying and being skilled at interacting with other people. Frequently discussed as a desirable quality in job applicants, children, and well-adjusted adults.

examples.japanese: {社交性|しゃこうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{社交性|しゃこうせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{欠|か}ける→欠ける：13167_kakeru⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧のうち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{社交性|しゃこうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}につける→身につける：03158_minitsukeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: It's important to develop sociability during childhood.

examples.japanese: ⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧{社交性|しゃこうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Sales jobs require a high level of sociability.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{社交|しゃこう}→社交：13742_shakou⟧ ('socializing; social interaction') and the suffix ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ ('-ness; -ity; nature'). The ⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧ suffix attaches to many nouns to form abstract trait words: ⟦{可能性|かのうせい}→可能性：04818_kanousei⟧ ('possibility'), ⟦{重要性|じゅうようせい}→重要性：04823_juuyousei⟧ ('importance'), ⟦{個性|こせい}→個性：11536_kosei⟧ ('individuality').

USAGE:
Most often appears in descriptions of personality and in job-related discussions of desirable traits. Phrased as {社交性|しゃこうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧/⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ ('to have/lack sociability') or {社交性|しゃこうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧/⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧ ('to have high/low sociability').

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {社交性|しゃこうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to be sociable
- {社交性|しゃこうせい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{欠|か}ける→欠ける：13167_kakeru⟧: to lack sociability
- {社交性|しゃこうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: highly sociable
- {社交性|しゃこうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{身|み}につける→身につける：03158_minitsukeru⟧: to develop sociability
- {社交性|しゃこうせい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{養|やしな}う→養う：04478_yashinau⟧: to cultivate sociability
- {社交性|しゃこうせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められる→求める：02316_motomeru⟧: sociability is required

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{社交的|しゃこうてき}→社交的：08457_shakouteki⟧: sociable (adjective form) — ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{社交的|しゃこうてき}→社交的：08457_shakouteki⟧だ ('He is sociable')
- ⟦{協調性|きょうちょうせい}→協調性：16440_kyouchousei⟧: cooperativeness — working well in a group rather than socializing per se
- ⟦{人当|ひとあ}たり→人当たり：21073_hitoatari⟧: manner toward others; how one comes across — more about first impression
- ⟦{愛想|あいそ}→愛想：12699_aiso⟧: amiability; sociability — often in ⟦{愛想|あいそ}がいい→愛想がいい：16502_aisogaii⟧ ('affable, friendly')
- ⟦{内向的|ないこうてき}→内向的：08458_naikouteki⟧: introverted — opposite trait
